extracted.name: Matcha chiffon cake using rice cooker (easy)
extracted.description: Great recipe for Matcha chiffon cake using rice cooker (easy).
instruction_lines: Mix well the dry ingredients altogether in a bowl. Add eggs, milk and mix them well. Meanwhile melt the white chocolate and mix it with the combination. Pour it into the rice cooker and cook it till it’s well done. Enjoy 😊
